description: Erection of a two storey front extension, a single storey rear extension, conversion of loft space involving a dormer extensions at side and rear, and rooflights to side roofslope, provision of new front porch roof, raised patio with steps to rear and installation of a 2 metres high boundary fence as measured from the floor level of the raised patio area on the side boundary with No.16 Burdon Lane and alterations to render and fenestrations.
decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

Prior to installation, details of the insulation render to be used on the exterior of the building(s) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved materials shall be used in the construction of the development hereby approved, completed prior to its occupation/use and retained thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the area and to ensure compliance with Policies 28 and 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018. This condition is required to ensure that materials are considered at a early stageof the construction process and it is important that details are agreed at this stage as this could potentially impact on construction method.

Apart from the windows indicated in the approved plans and drawings, no further windows shall be provided in the side elevations of the permitted development at first and second floor levels.Reason:  To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to occupation, the proposed first floor side facing windows, shall be fitted with obscure glazing and be non-opening up to a height of 1.7m above floor level  and shall be retained and maintained thereafter.Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and to ensure compliance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the FIRE SAFETY STATEMENT by VIRTUS DESIGN & BUILD unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.

The flat roof sections of the rear extension hereby approved shall not be used, all or in part, as a terrace or other amenity space. No railings, fences, walls or other means of enclosure shall be erected on these flat roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the rear and side elevations of the application property to form access onto these roofs.Reason: Such a use could be harmful to the existing amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring residential properties as a result of overlooking and loss of privacy and the generation of noise and disturbance contrary to Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The use of the raised patio area shall not commence until the 2 metres high screens as measured from the floor level of the raised patio area on the side boundary with No.16 Burdon Lane as indicated on the approved drawing No. 500-100 Rev 04 have been installed and they shall be permanently retained as such thereafter.Reason: In order to ensure that the use of the raised timber decking area as terrace would not result in overlooking and any subsequent loss of privacy to neighbouring residents in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
